summary: Authored stakeholder memo communicating a 3-week subscription launch delay to fix a high-severity payment security vulnerability.
evidence: Opened directly with business and timeline impact (3-week delay from Nov 15 to Dec 6) in the first sentence.
Translated technical terms (tokenization, token replay) using plain language and the digital ticket stub / hotel key card copy analogy.
Framed the tradeoff between launch timeliness and catastrophic security/brand breach clearly.
Concluded with a concrete 3-part ask (Product approval, Marketing timeline adjustment, and a specific 30-minute sync time on Thursday at 2:00 PM EST).
